content: {"praised":["Nancy Meyers directs brisk pacing and strong storytelling.","Mel Gibson delivers a solid, engaging performance.","Helen Hunt portrays a successful, inspiring career woman.","The cast is fantastic and well-acted.","The film has aged well, maintaining its charm."],"criticized":["Story is inane and lacks humor or emotion.","Mel Gibson's character is patronizing and manipulative.","Women portrayed as helpless losers needing male help.","Script is vapid, with stuttering lines and weak dialogue.","Transformation to telepathy feels unrealistic and poorly explained."]}
